lineage-blue.note: Structural accent: active/lineage/focus, DAG edges, nav underline, primary button, SQL keywords. Bright value for fills/edges; lightText for accent-as-text on the light surface.

mart-amber.note: dbt mart layer — project case studies, headline metrics.

exposure-green.note: Exposures + live status — contact, ready build state, open-to-work pill.

window.note: The main editor surface behind content.

ink.note: Primary reading ink; ramp runs ink-bright → ink-lower.

display.purpose: The name on the identity/about model. One per surface (40px, 34px in modals).

body.purpose: Prose held to ~65–75ch (14.5–16px IBM Plex Sans).

label.purpose: Machine voice — paths, layer tags, COMPILED stamps, breadcrumbs (JetBrains Mono, tracked).

shadows.name: window
shadows.purpose: The app window lifting off the dot-grid.

shadows.name: node-hover
shadows.purpose: DAG node on hover — colored ring + lift.

motion.name: hover-lift
motion.purpose: Universal 2px hover lift on cards, tags, buttons.

motion.name: edge-pulse
motion.purpose: Data pulse traveling each DAG edge source→target; pathLength-normalized.

motion.name: nav-underline
motion.purpose: Active nav underline slides between links.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) → animations collapse to ~0ms; DAG pulse disabled, static edge only

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.note: Below this the IDE collapses to stacked sections + compact top bar.

components.name: Primary Button (resume.pdf)
components.description: The single filled element on a surface — download/primary CTA in Lineage Blue.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: var(--c-accent-blue, #5b9dff); color: #04101f; font-family: var(--font-jetbrains), ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.5px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.18s ease-out, filter 0.18s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Hairline-bordered utility button — search, run, theme toggle.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--c-ink-muted, #9fb0c9); font-family: var(--font-jetbrains), ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11.5px; padding: 5px 11px; border: 1px solid var(--c-line-mid, #243049); border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--c-ink, #e6ecf5); } .ds-btn-ghost__hint { color: var(--c-ink-low, #5d6b88); }

components.name: Content Card
components.description: Hairline-bordered content card; lifts 2px and shifts border on hover.
components.html:
Data Engineer2023 — now

Built and owned the lineage from raw sources to marts.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--c-card, #0b1322); border: 1px solid var(--c-line, #1c2740); border-radius: 0; padding: 15px 17px; transition: transform 0.18s ease-out, border-color 0.18s ease-out; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: var(--c-line-hover, #2a3958); } .ds-card__head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 12px; } .ds-card__title { font-family: var(--font-plex), system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--c-ink-bright, #f1f5fb); } .ds-card__span { font-family: var(--font-jetbrains), monospace; font-size: 12px; color: var(--c-ink-ghost, #7e8ba6); } .ds-card__body { margin: 7px 0 0; font-family: var(--font-plex), system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--c-ink-dim, #b8c4d6); }

components.name: Tag / Chip
components.description: Mono pill on a hairline border; lifts on hover.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; background: var(--c-chrome, #0c1322); color: var(--c-ink-muted, #9fb0c9); font-family: var(--font-jetbrains), monospace; font-size: 12px; padding: 5px 11px; border: 1px solid var(--c-line-mid, #243049); border-radius: 0; transition: transform 0.18s ease-out, border-color 0.18s ease-out, color 0.18s ease-out; } .ds-tag:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: var(--c-line-hover, #2a3958); color: var(--c-ink-soft, #d4ddea); }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Command-palette / console input — mono, hairline, blinking caret accent.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="jump to a model…" />
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: var(--c-card, #0b1322); color: var(--c-ink, #e6ecf5); font-family: var(--font-jetbrains), monospace; font-size: 13.5px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--c-line-mid, #243049); border-radius: 0; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--c-ink-low, #5d6b88); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--c-accent-blue, #5b9dff); }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Open-to-work / build status — accent text on a faint same-hue tint, with a pulsing dot.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font-family: var(--font-jetbrains), monospace; font-size: 12px; padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 0; color: var(--c-accent-green, #4ade80); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-accent-green, #4ade80) 38%, transparent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-accent-green, #4ade80) 12%, transparent); } .ds-pill__dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--c-accent-green, #4ade80); animation: ds-pulse 2s infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(74,222,128,0.5); } 70% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 7px rgba(74,222,128,0); } 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(74,222,128,0); } }

components.name: DAG Node
components.description: Signature lineage node — layer tag + model name + subtitle; lifts to accent border + glow on hover.
components.css: .ds-node { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; text-align: left; width: 300px; padding: 14px; background: var(--c-chrome, #0c1322); border: 1px solid var(--c-line-mid, #243049); border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: var(--shadow-node, 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)); transition: transform 0.2s ease-out, border-color 0.2s ease-out, box-shadow 0.2s ease-out; } .ds-node:hover { transform: scale(1.025); border-color: var(--c-accent-teal, #2dd4bf); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-accent-teal, #2dd4bf) 19%, transparent), var(--shadow-node-hover, 0 10px 26px rgba(0,0,0,0.45)); } .ds-node__top { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; } .ds-node__dot { width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--c-accent-teal, #2dd4bf); } .ds-node__kind { font-family: var(--font-jetbrains), monospace; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 1px; color: var(--c-ink-muted, #9fb0c9); } .ds-node__hint { margin-left: auto; font-family: var(--font-jetbrains), monospace; font-size: 9px; color: var(--c-ink-muted, #9fb0c9); } .ds-node__name { margin-top: 4px; font-family: var(--font-jetbrains), monospace; font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; color: var(--c-ink, #e6ecf5); } .ds-node__sub { font-family: var(--font-jetbrains), monospace; font-size: 12px; color: var(--c-ink-faint, #8a97ad); }

components.name: Nav Link (active)
components.description: Mono nav link with an animated Lineage-Blue underline on the active item.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; font-family: var(--font-jetbrains), monospace; font-size: 12px; } .ds-nav__link { position: relative; background: transparent; border: none; padding: 5px 10px; color: var(--c-ink-ghost, #7e8ba6); cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s ease-out; } .ds-nav__link:hover { color: var(--c-ink, #e6ecf5); } .ds-nav__link--active { color: var(--c-ink, #e6ecf5); } .ds-nav__link--active::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 8px; right: 8px; bottom: -1px; height: 2px; background: var(--c-accent-blue, #5b9dff); }

narrative.overview: Every section of this portfolio is a dbt model. The source — SQL or YAML — sits on top in a real code block; the rendered, human-readable fact compiles below it, stamped COMPILED · 1 row. The whole site is the artifact: an IDE shell wrapped around a drill-down DAG where src.prajwal descends into stg.experience, mart.projects, stg.skills. The design doesn't claim data-engineering competence; it renders as the tool that competence is practiced in. The voice is minimal, calm, and editorial — confident through restraint. It ships dark by default and light by choice, both themes engineered to clear WCAG AA independently.
keyCharacteristics: Sharp corners everywhere — border-radius: 0 enforced globally; only dots are round.
Dual-theme by CSS variable — every surface/ink color is a --c-* token; nothing is raw hex.
Mono for the machine, sans for the human — JetBrains Mono for paths/code/labels, IBM Plex Sans for prose.
One structural accent (Lineage Blue) + layer-coded semantic accents (teal/amber/green/purple).
Quiet motion: a 2px lift on hover, staggered reveals, and data pulsing through the DAG edges.

rules.name: The Lineage Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue is structural, not decorative — active/focused/on the path. Other accents are layer codes; reach for teal or amber only when the thing genuinely belongs to that dbt layer.

rules.name: The Dual-Surface Rule
rules.body: No raw hex in components. Every surface/ink color is a --c-* variable, and both themes must independently clear AA (body ≥4.5:1, large ≥3:1).

rules.name: The Rationed-Accent Rule
rules.body: Bright accents are for fills/dots/borders/edges; accent text, numbers, and the status pill use the darkened --c-accent-* text variant.

rules.name: The Mono-for-Machine Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono for what a machine emits (code, paths, tags, metrics, provenance); IBM Plex Sans for what a human writes (names, headings, prose). Never blur the two.

rules.name: The Compiled-Fact Rule
rules.body: Content arrives as a compiled result of code shown directly above it. Keep the source → compile → fact rhythm.

rules.name: The Sharp-Edge Rule
rules.body: border-radius is 0 on every box; the Tailwind radius scale is hard-zeroed. The only round things are dots and the window traffic-lights (.dot, 9999px).

rules.name: The Theme-Tuned Shadow Rule
rules.body: Never cast a black shadow on the light surface. Shadows are --shadow-* variables — deep black on dark, soft slate-tinted on light.

dos: Do keep border-radius: 0 on every box. Round only dots and the window traffic-lights via .dot.
Do route every color through a --c-* variable or Tailwind token, and verify both themes clear AA independently (body ≥4.5:1, large ≥3:1).
Do reserve Lineage Blue for structure (active/lineage/focus) and use teal/amber/green accents only for their dbt layer.
Do split type strictly: JetBrains Mono for machine output, IBM Plex Sans for human prose.
Do keep motion quiet — a 2px hover lift, staggered list reveals, and the one DAG-edge pulse. Always ship a prefers-reduced-motion fallback.
Do preface rendered content with its compiled source (models / x.sql → code → COMPILED).
donts: Don't let the IDE metaphor become a busy, dashboard-y surface — cramped panels, competing data, viz-for-its-own-sake.
Don't reach for neon dark-mode theatrics — gamer-RGB glow, saturated cyber gradients, hacker-terminal costume.
Don't ship generic SaaS-template / bootcamp-portfolio moves — stock hero gradients, identical card grids, or an eyebrow above every section.
Don't use a border-left/border-right colored side-stripe to emphasize a card. Use a full border + a mono marker.
Don't type an accent hex into a component, and never cast a black shadow on the light surface.
Don't set body prose in mono or a file path in sans. The machine/human split is load-bearing.
